comparisons.reason: Both are all-comments binary over OC_comments with the same null rule, but the disqualifying concrete element differs. Spec 0 returns 0 only for a specific, verifiable procedural example (an actual procedure, process, rule or practice that could be checked). Spec 92 returns 0 for a concrete external factual analogy or any other concrete external example based on a specific real-world case, event or fact. Spec 92 is broader and covers non-procedural real-world cases, so a comment citing a real event gives 0 in 92 but may give 1 in 0. The two features have different eligibility and thresholds.
